82096.body:

Автор: Forbes

Good evening, After sweeping both chambers of Congress, Democrats are starting to plan their agenda for the new term. On that agenda is launching numerous investigations into Elon Musk, a key ally of Donald Trump and the year’s biggest political donor, and his businesses. However, if they hope to curb his power without impeding U.S. national security, they will have to be extremely deliberate. Here's why that is. In other Musk news, the Tesla CEO says the electric car maker will wind down production of the Cybertruck at its Texas Gigafactory next year. Here's why. Thanks for reading!
